Liam Novak
liam.novak@example.com | New York, NY
Liam Novak has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Silverline Software (2025-2026), where
they applied distributed-systems patterns to scale the platform to 456K
concurrent users. Before that, Backend Engineer at Timberline Infrastructure
(2024-2025). Before that, Software Engineer I at Harborlight Solutions
(2018-2024). Education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, Columbia University, 2018.
Core skills: CI/CD, Kafka, Docker, REST API design, TypeScript, Distributed
systems, Terraform, Redis, AWS, Node.js.
